As Sales Account Manager Export, you will be responsible for expanding and strengthening our business across international markets outside Western Europe.
 

You will focus primarily on developing relationships with large customers and distributors, ensuring sustainable growth and long-term partnerships.
 

You combine a strategic outlook with a hands-on approach to drive sales performance and unlock new opportunities.
 

Key responsibilities:
 

• Develop and manage relationships with key accounts and international distributors 

• Drive sales growth across export markets outside Western Europe 

• Identify and develop new business opportunities in assigned regions 

• Negotiate commercial agreements and contracts 

• Set-up, manage, motivate, and support a network of agents 

• Monitor sales performance and ensure targets are achieved 

• Analyze market trends and customer needs to define growth strategies 

• Collaborate closely with internal teams including marketing, customer service, and supply chain 

• Represent the company at international trade fairs and customer meetings 

• You will translate internal commercial strategies into action and continuously improve the end-to-end sales process via our CRM platform (Dynamics 365).

• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented

• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus) 

• Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis

Are you looking for an active night shift job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?
Then this might be your new challenge!

You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.

As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.

- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.
- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.
- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the correct location.
- You work with an electric pallet truck.
- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.
- Vaardigheden:
You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.
You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.
You can work without any problems in a frozen environment of -22°C.
You enjoy active work.
You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.

- Attesten:
Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
No diploma required.

- Talenkennis:
Good knowledge of English

About the role   You will provide administrative and logistical support to our association management teams  to deliver high-quality services and value to our clients. In coordinating and communicating with our volunteer groups and committees, you will also support our associations’ mission and activities.
 

Duties and Responsibilities   

 
• bull;    Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, reports, and presentations for board, committee and working party meetings. Coordinate with all attendees. 
 
• bull;    Facilitate meetings, capturing action items and decisions. Manage post-meeting activities such as distributing minutes, tracking all action items and following up on outstanding items. 
 
• bull;    Provide administrative support, including scheduling, travel arrangements, and expense management. 
 
• bull;    Support with managing administration for corporate partnership deals and sponsorship agreements. 
 
• bull;    Track and manage the administration of grants and awards for a health care association. 
 
• bull;    Maintain governance documents, policies, and other relevant materials in a centralised repository. 
 
• bull;    Assist with the planning and execution of association events, programs, and projects. 
 
• bull;    Liaise with volunteer groups and committees and provide them with guidance, resources, and feedback. 
 
• bull;    Handle inquiries from members, partners, and the public and direct them to the appropriate person or department. 
 
• bull;    Organise and maintain files, records, and databases. 
 

Your profile   Eligible to work in the EU. At least three years’ experience in an administrative or support role, preferably in a non-profit or association setting. Fluent in English (verbal and written level C1), Knowledge of another language is an asset. Proficient in the Microsoft Office package, Google Suite, and other web-based tools. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a diverse team. Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise and multitask. You are flexible, agile and committed especially in busy periods. Knowledge of and interest in the association's field and mission. Willingness to travel abroad for certain meetings and events. Available to join the team rapidly.

You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.
• Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.
• Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.
• Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.
• Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.
• Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.
• Register and follow up on customer complaints, returns and other order-related issues.
• Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality and other departments.
 

• You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment. 
• You are customer-focused, organized and comfortable managing different priorities and administrative tasks.
• You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

What will you do?

• Clean the interiors of tankers, bulk trucks, container trucks and other vehicles.
• Operate a forklift to move materials and goods.
• Ensure that cleaning orders are carried out correctly.
• Carefully monitor the work during cleaning activities.
• Refill cleaning products in a timely manner.
• Perform general cleaning and maintenance of the workplace.
• Comply with applicable safety and quality regulations.
• Work together with colleagues to complete cleaning assignments efficiently.

Who are you?

• You are characterised by motivation, a willingness to learn and a hands-on mentality.
• Speaking Dutch, English or German is not a problem for you.
• Good physical fitness is important, as this is a physically demanding job; candidates must not suffer from back problems.
• You are comfortable working at heights or in smaller, enclosed spaces.
• Working safely and using the necessary personal protective equipment is second nature to you.
• Experience operating a forklift is required; a forklift certificate is an advantage, but not essential.
• You do not wear glasses, or you are willing to wear contact lenses.
• Basic knowledge of computer programs is an advantage.
• You are able to work both independently and as part of a team.
• Accuracy and a strong sense of responsibility are among your strengths.
• Your own means of transport is essential, as the workplace is not accessible by public transport.
• Experience in industrial cleaning or the cleaning sector is an advantage, but motivation is the priority.

The Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH will manage pricing and tender processes within the life sciences industry, ensuring accuracy and compliance. This role is focused on delivering high-quality customer service support.

Client Details

Our client is an international company active in medical supplies and accessories.

They are looking for a temporary (but with probability of becoming permanent) Tender & Pricing Coordinator who is fluent in German and English.

Description

As a Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH you will have two main pillars:

 

1) Pricing

 

• You analyse pricing strategies and habits in your markets and develop the company's pricing structure
• You make sure prices get approved and implemented
• You communicate new price quotations to your customers
• You are responsible for implementing your pricing in SAP
• You update price catalogues
 

2) Tender & Sales Support

 

• You manage tender processes from A to Z (preparation, analyses, contracts, pitches, ...)
• You communicate important contract changes
• You monitor the tender renewals
• You analyze clients complaints regarding contracting and pricing
 

 

 

 

A successful Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH should have:

• Experience in tender, pricing and customer service or administrative roles
• Knowledge of pricing and tender processes
• Strong organisational and multitasking skills
• Attention to detail and accuracy in handling documents
• Proficiency in IT tools, particularly Excel and SAP
• Fluency in English and German
• Ideally your are immediately available

Project & Programme Management

• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.

• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.

Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

Stakeholder Management

• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.
